tools.name: list_wedding_markets
tools.description: List the countries, regions and vendor categories Wedyesday supports, with the exact values to pass to the other Wedyesday tools. Call this first when you do not already know a valid country code, region slug or vendor category.

tools.name: search_wedding_vendors
tools.description: Search Wedyesday's directory of wedding vendors — venues, photographers, caterers, florists, celebrants and more. Returns real published listings with ratings, price bands and a link to each profile. Use list_wedding_markets first if you are unsure which category or country code to pass.

tools.name: get_wedding_cost_guide
tools.description: Get typical wedding costs for a region — a low/typical/high total plus a category-by-category breakdown (venue, catering, photography and so on). Use this to answer 'how much does a wedding cost' questions with real regional figures rather than estimates.

tools.name: build_wedding_plan
tools.description: Build a personalised wedding plan: a month-by-month checklist with real due dates, a budget split for the couple's region, and how their budget compares to typical local spend. This is the same planning engine as the Wedyesday website, so nothing here is invented. Nothing is saved and no account is

tools.name: create_wedyesday_workspace_link
tools.description: Turn a wedding plan into a private link the couple can open to save it as a free Wedyesday workspace — checklist, budget, guest list, RSVPs and a wedding website. Pass the same answers used for build_wedding_plan. This creates no account and stores no personal details; the couple signs up themselves

tools.name: get_my_wedding_dashboard
tools.description: Get an overview of the signed-in couple's Wedyesday wedding: date, countdown, checklist progress, budget position and what is due next, plus a direct link to their dashboard. Start here for any question about 'my wedding'. Requires a connected Wedyesday account.

tools.name: list_my_wedding_tasks
tools.description: List tasks from the couple's Wedyesday checklist, newest deadlines first. Filter to what is overdue, due soon, or already done. Requires a connected Wedyesday account.

tools.name: add_my_wedding_task
tools.description: Add a task to the couple's Wedyesday checklist. Confirm the wording and the due date with the couple before calling this — it writes to their real workspace. Requires a connected Wedyesday account.

tools.name: complete_my_wedding_task
tools.description: Mark a task on the couple's Wedyesday checklist as done. Get the task id from list_my_wedding_tasks first, and confirm with the couple which task they mean. Requires a connected Wedyesday account.

tools.name: get_my_wedding_budget
tools.description: Get the couple's Wedyesday budget: planned versus actual by category, what is left, and any payments due or overdue. Requires a connected Wedyesday account.

tools.name: get_my_guest_list
tools.description: Get a summary of the couple's Wedyesday guest list: headcount, groups, how many have contact details on file, plus_ones and children. Guests' email addresses and phone numbers are never returned — those stay in the dashboard. Requires a connected Wedyesday account.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "add_my_wedding_task" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Add a task to the couple's Wedyesday checklist. Confirm the wording and the due date with the couple before calling this — it writes to their real workspace. Re…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.wedyesday.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_guest_list · Private data: create_wedyesday_workspace_link, get_my_guest_list · Public sink: get_my_guest_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_my_guest_list · Private data: create_wedyesday_workspace_link, get_my_guest_list · Public sink: get_my_guest_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
